reviews.reason: I18nCatalogPage 分开过滤草稿/已应用过滤/分页/编辑/确认；mutation 成功通过 refreshCatalog helper invalidate settingsI18nCatalogQueryKey；filters 是组合 slot。 接收方公开 ReactNode slot 专用于 status/filters/notice 组合，JSX 是接口的实际用途。 Reassessed 2026-11-03: Translation save chooses custom-upsert versus override-upsert, with separate restore/delete/create/activate grants. refreshCatalog still invalidates the catalog owner; filter/edit/confirmation state axes remain independent.
